_comment: SPARK — S152 P3 atlas specs, one entry per character, consumed by scripts/build-sprite-atlas.mjs.
RETAINED IN-TREE: S151 shipped three atlases and kept no spec, so they could not be rebuilt or
retuned — which is exactly why the owner's 'redo the stink tower' needed a full regeneration.
ticksPerFrame values match the shipped melee/archer atlases so the new goblins animate at the
same cadence as their siblings: idle 7, walk 4, attack 5 (the stink tower keeps its own 6 / 4).
cellW is a FLOOR, not a cap: the builder widens it to fit a prop at full character height, which
is why the archer's shipped cell is 234 rather than 200 (his bow).

_why_sapper: The CreatureType is `goblinSuicide` and the owner calls it the 'terrorist goblin', but the
asset is named `goblin-sapper`: veo refuses prompts that read as a suicide bomber, so the
character was framed as a comedic sapper hugging an oversized cartoon bomb. The name follows
the art. ATLASES maps goblinSuicide -> this path, and that link is documented there.
specs.name: goblin-sapper

_why_batrider: The FLYER. There is no altitude support in goblinRenderer: footAnchor.y is forced to ~0.995
by the builder and the sprite is planted on c.pos.y, so without help the bat's feet sit on
the ground. S152 P3 adds a per-type LIFT in the renderer rather than trying to bake headroom
into the cell — the builder's union-bbox crop would remove baked headroom anyway.
specs.name: goblin-batrider

_why_stink: REBUILT ON OWNER INSTRUCTION ('the currently implemented stink tower is shit'). Same output
path as the shipped one so stinkTowerRenderer needs no change — this REPLACES the atlas whose
branch count changed between frames. Two states only: the renderer has no walk for a tower.
specs.name: stink-tower

_sampleWindow_note: sampleWindow values are MEASURED from contact sheets, not chosen. veo holds an image-to-video seed
for roughly the first second then drifts, and the ATTACK clip is worst in every character because
the renderer HOLDS an attack's final frame through the recovery half of the cadence — a degraded
last frame is therefore the pose on screen longest. Clips are 4s @ 24fps = 96 frames.
shield/attack 30: it zoomed out AND slid across frame, inflating the shared union bbox to 1187px
and shrinking every other state with it. batrider all 36: the goblin turned spindly and washed out
broadly, not just late. sapper/attack 36: its final frame became a mangled double-headed figure.
stink-tower/attack 48: the lightning spread frame-wide late, shrinking the tower vs its own idle.
_enclosedWhite_note: enclosedWhiteLimitPct 0.0002 (=0.02% of frame, ~184px) on every S152 character. MEASURED, not
chosen: on the bat rider the enclosed BACKGROUND pockets are 446-14291px while every real feature
(eyes, teeth, spear glints) is <=24px - an 18x gap, so any threshold between them is safe.
The builder default stays 0.003 so the shipped melee/archer atlases cannot regress.
